meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-16 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Lights out 22:36, up at 06:18 — 7h 21m asleep inside 7h 42m in bed. That is 1h 20m more than the night before and 29 minutes over the 6h 52m seven-night average, the third-longest night of the window and the first one above average since Tuesday. The score came in at 84, up 8 from 76 and level with Sunday's 84 for the best of the seven: 84, 82, 82, 81, 68, 76, 84. The reason is entirely bedtime — 22:36 is the earliest lights-out of the week bar one minute (Monday's 22:35), and it is two full hours earlier than Thursday's 00:44. Two nights of correction have now undone that one. The stage mix is the honest caveat. Deep came in at 65 minutes, 15% of the night, second-lowest of the window after Monday's 61 and well under the 100-101 the body was pulling on Wednesday and Thursday. REM recovered strongly to 89 minutes from 62, the best since Sunday's 111. Light took the extra time — 287 minutes, second only to Tuesday's 304. Awake time rose to 21 minutes from 7, so efficiency slipped to 96% from Friday's 98%, tying Monday for the most restless night of the block. Read together: you bought a long, light, REM-rich night rather than a deep one, which is the normal shape after a big aerobic day rather than a hard one. The autonomics kept improving. HRV reached 39, up 1 and 2 over the 37 average — a second consecutive rise and the highest since Monday's 42, with the 33, 34, 34 soft patch now three nights behind. Morning stress reads 20, the lowest of the window against full-day values of 35, 32, 32, 39, 33, 35. Body Battery has charged 52 and drained 2 so far this morning. Readiness 78, good. The one holdout is still RHR: 55 for the third straight morning and pinned at the top of its 53-55 band, which is the expected lag after yesterday's 4h 27m Zagreb hike — 16.5 km, 573 m of climbing, 23,294 steps and 1,912 kcal, the largest single session of the week. Sleep has done its part; give the legs a light day and the RHR should follow.

hr.rec: Gašenje svjetla u 22:36, ustajanje u 06:18 — 7h 21m sna unutar 7h 42m u krevetu. To je 1h 20m više nego prethodne noći i 29 minuta iznad sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 6h 52m, treća najdulja noć u prozoru i prva iznad prosjeka od utorka. Ocjena je 84, osam više od 76 i izjednačena s nedjeljnih 84 kao najbolja od sedam: 84, 82, 82, 81, 68, 76, 84. Razlog je isključivo lijeganje — 22:36 je najranije gašenje svjetla u tjednu uz razliku od jedne minute (ponedjeljak 22:35) i puna dva sata ranije od četvrtkovih 00:44. Dvije noći ispravka poništile su onu jednu. Raspored faza je poštena ograda. Duboki san iznosio je 65 minuta, 15% noći, drugi najniži u prozoru nakon ponedjeljkove 61 i znatno ispod 100-101 koliko je tijelo vuklo u srijedu i četvrtak. REM se snažno oporavio na 89 minuta s 62, najbolje od nedjeljnih 111. Višak vremena uzeo je lagani san — 287 minuta, odmah iza utorkovih 304. Budnost je porasla na 21 minutu sa 7, pa je učinkovitost pala na 96% s petkovih 98%, izjednačeno s ponedjeljkom kao najnemirnija noć bloka. Zajedno: kupio si dugu, laganu noć bogatu REM-om umjesto duboke, što je normalan oblik nakon velikog aerobnog, a ne teškog dana. Autonomika se i dalje popravlja. HRV je dosegao 39, jedan više i dva iznad prosjeka od 37 — drugi uzastopni rast i najviše od ponedjeljkovih 42, a mlaki niz 33, 34, 34 sada je tri noći iza. Jutarnji stres iznosi 20, najniže u prozoru naspram cjelodnevnih vrijednosti 35, 32, 32, 39, 33, 35. Body Battery se jutros napunio 52, a potrošio 2. Spremnost 78, dobra. Jedini zaostatak i dalje je RHR: 55 treće jutro zaredom i prikovan na vrhu raspona 53-55, što je očekivano kašnjenje nakon jučerašnjeg planinarenja po Zagrebu od 4h 27m — 16,5 km, 573 m uspona, 23.294 koraka i 1.912 kcal, najveći pojedinačni trening tjedna. San je odradio svoje; daj nogama lagani dan i RHR bi trebao krenuti za njim.
